itembox.description: Touching this rotating box starts an item lottery. Its item pools and timing can be changed per placement.

2.label: Player item type
2.description: Item box item type for human players.

3.label: CPU item type
3.description: Item box item type for computer players.

4.label: Disable shadow
4.description: Hides the box shadow when set; any nonzero value hides it.

6.label: Lottery timing
6.description: Changes roulette duration and item-box respawn time. Short roulette does not work online.

7.label: Height offset
7.description: Signed offset from the object position.

DummyPole.description: Controls solidity of a pole already present in the course model.

1.label: Wall variant
1.description: KCL wall variant used for the pole.

kuribo.description: Goomba that walks along a route and reappears after being hit.

1.label: Respawn time
1.description: Time before the Goomba reappears after being hit; the game range is not documented.

2.label: Speed
2.description: Route movement speed. A value of 32 (0x20) is a documented working example.

3.label: Animation speed
3.description: Movement animation speed; the game range is not documented.

choropu.description: Moving Monty Mole from Moo Moo Meadows. Its route determines where it burrows or emerges.
choropu.notes: Do not use choropu and choropu2 together; they share a model resource.

2.label: Start delay
2.description: Delay in frames (60 frames = one second).

choropu2.description: Alternate Monty Mole that appears at a fixed position.
choropu2.notes: Do not use choropu and choropu2 together.

1.label: Hide time
1.description: How long the Monty Mole stays hidden, in frames (60 frames = one second).

2.label: Start delay
2.description: Frames before it first appears.

cow.description: A leader cow follows a route while other cows begin near the object position.

1.label: Following cows
1.description: Number of cows behind the leader; the supported maximum is not documented.

3.label: Follower delay
3.description: Start delay of the following cows, in frames (60 frames = one second).

4.label: Leader lead time
4.description: How much earlier the leader cow starts, in frames.

dossunc.description: Thwomp obstacle that stomps in place or uses a route for more complex motion.
dossunc.notes: Without a route, settings 1 and 2 should be zero.

1.label: Route speed
1.description: Set to 0 when no route is assigned.

2.label: Route behaviour
2.description: Set to 0 when no route is assigned.

options.2: Paired Thwomps moving sideways, then down

3.label: Start delay
3.description: Frames after countdown starts; 240 (0xF0) starts immediately after GO.

4.label: Sleep time
4.description: Time asleep after countdown starts, in frames.

pakkun_f.description: Attacking Piranha Plant, normally paired with its pipe.

1.label: Idle time
1.description: Frames between attacks in Time Trial and online races.

pakkun_dokan.description: Pipe used with the attacking Piranha Plant.

wanwan.description: Chained Chain Chomp that lunges toward a target area.

1.label: Chain length
1.description: Chain length in game units.

4.label: Target X
4.description: Signed target X coordinate divided by 10.

5.label: Target Z
5.description: Signed target Z coordinate divided by 10.

6.label: Wander time
6.description: Frames spent wandering. Zero uses about 5 seconds; add about 3.5 seconds for the full cycle.

7.label: Lunge angle
7.description: Encoded as (wedge width in degrees − 35) / 2; the supported angular range is not documented.

Hwanwan.description: Route-following Chain Chomp from DS Peach Gardens.
Hwanwan.notes: Use a curved route for this object.

2.label: Carried item boxes
2.description: Number of item boxes carried.

poihana.description: Cataquack that flings players upward. In races it can seek nearby players.

1.label: Colour
1.description: PAT0 body colour frame; a custom PAT0 may provide more colours.
1.limits: A custom PAT0 may have more frames.

2.label: Detection distance
2.description: Distance at which it starts seeking players.

DKrockGC.description: Rolling rock from GCN DK Mountain that follows a route.
DKrockGC.notes: The route must use back-and-forth motion for the rock to respawn.

1.label: Second-rock delay
1.description: A nonzero value introduces an approximately 1.5-second delay for the second rock.
1.limits: Any nonzero value adds the delay.

2.label: Minimum cycle
2.description: Minimum cycle time in frames (60 frames = one second).

5.label: Additional flag
5.description: Only value 1 is documented on GCN DK Mountain.
5.limits: Other values have no documented effect.

sanbo.description: Pokey from Dry Dry Ruins and DS Desert Hills that follows a route.
sanbo.notes: Route setting 1 controls the pause at each point in frames.

1.label: Speed
1.description: Movement speed along the route.

sanbo_big.description: Large Pokey variant used in a tournament.

hanachan.description: Wiggler from Maple Treeway that follows a route.
hanachan.notes: Route setting 1 controls pauses. Keep the route at suitable heights.

basabasa.description: Flying Swoopers that cross the course.

1.label: Speed
1.description: Flying speed of the bats along the route.

2.label: Delay until next group
2.description: Frames between two groups of bats.

3.label: Swoops per group
3.description: How many bats each group sends.

4.label: Distance off the route
4.description: How far the bats spread from the route.
4.values: The exact scale is not documented.

6.label: Distance between bats
6.description: Spacing of the bats in a group.

FireSnake.description: Ground-level fire enemy associated with DS Desert Hills.

1.label: Sun route
1.description: Route used by the sun that releases it.

2.label: Lifetime
2.description: Time before disappearing, in frames.

crab.description: Crab obstacle from GBA Shy Guy Beach that follows a route.

1.label: Speed
1.description: Units per frame (60 frames = one second).

2.label: Facing direction
2.description: Direction of the crab along the route.

car_body.description: Traffic car from Moonview Highway. Its route controls the path and blink direction.

2.label: Speed mode 0
2.description: Speed for route setting 2 = 0.

kart_truck.description: Traffic truck from Moonview Highway that follows a route.

TruckWagon.description: Mine cart obstacle that moves along the track.

1.label: Speed
1.description: Speed of the mine carts along the route.

2.label: Delay before the second group
2.description: Frames between the first and the second group of carts.

3.label: Delay until the first group
3.description: Frames before the first group starts.

4.label: Collision
4.description: Whether karts collide with the carts.

seagull.description: Seagull that flies along a route.

1.label: Speed
1.description: Flight speed along the route.

2.label: Seagull count
2.description: Number of birds; the supported maximum is not documented.

Epropeller.description: Electric propeller obstacle from Koopa Cape.

1.label: Rotation speed
1.description: Number of rotations over 12 seconds in the normal game.

2.label: Direction
2.description: Direction of rotation.

8.label: Extended timing factor
8.description: Unused in the normal game. With LE-CODE or a compatible cheat, multiplies the period used by setting 1.
8.values: 0=normal 12-second period; positive values use 12 × setting 8 seconds.
8.limits: Only meaningful with the compatible extension.

WLfirebarGC.description: Rotating fire-bar obstacle from GCN Waluigi Stadium.

2.label: Rotation speed
2.description: Rotation speed and direction.

koopaFirebar.description: Rotating fire-bar obstacle from Bowser’s Castle.

2.label: Rotation speed
2.description: Rotation speed and direction.

WLfireringGC.description: Rotating ring of fireballs from GCN Waluigi Stadium.

2.label: Rotation speed
2.description: Rotation speed and direction.

3.label: Pulsation
3.values: 0=no pulsation; setting 3 ≥ setting 4 reverses the pulsation.

begoman_spike.description: Spiked Topman from Galaxy Colosseum; its rings and appearance times are controlled by settings.

1.label: Topman ID
1.description: One-based ID used by begoman_manager.
1.limits: The supported count depends on the manager configuration.

sun.description: Sun and lighting effect used by desert courses.

psea.description: Animated sea from GCN Peach Beach.

Psea.description: Animated sea from GCN Peach Beach.

lensFX.description: Lens flare positioned near the course light source.

venice_nami.description: Sea level effect from Delfino Pier, with several rising and falling stages.

1.label: Rising speed (odd stages)
1.description: Speed of the water in stages 1, 3 and 5.

2.label: Final height (stage 5)
2.description: Height the water reaches at the end.

3.label: Stage 1 target height
3.description: Height of the water after stage 1.

4.label: Stage 2 duration
4.description: Length of stage 2, in frames (60 frames = one second).

5.label: Stage 3 target height
5.description: Height of the water after stage 3.

7.label: Rising speed (even stages)
7.description: Speed of the water in stages 2 and 4.

1.label: Speed
1.description: Speed of the balloon's up and down movement.

2.label: Maximum height difference
2.description: How far it rises above its position.

kinoko_ud.description: Moving bouncy mushroom from Mushroom Gorge.

1.label: Dark stem
1.description: Texture of the stem.
1.values: Any nonzero value gives the dark stem.

2.label: Up-down amplitude
2.description: How far the mushroom moves up and down.

3.label: Cycle time
3.description: Length of one up-down cycle, in frames (60 frames = one second).

4.label: Cycle shift
4.description: Offset of the cycle, to make mushrooms move out of step.

5.label: Pause at the lowest point
5.description: Frames the mushroom waits at the bottom.

puchi_pakkun.description: Small Piranha Plant obstacle from N64 Mario Raceway.

2.label: Start delay
2.description: Frames before the first press.

airblock.description: Invisible box used as a barrier in tournaments.

coin.description: Collectible coin used in battle arenas.

1.label: Mode
1.description: Where the coin is used.

2.label: Start or respawn place
2.description: Whether the coin is there at the start or appears later at this place.
